name: Tear-off desk pad calendar

name: Zip-up hoodie

name: Crew-neck sweatshirt
description: A crew-neck sweatshirt for a team or event design. Share your size mix and front or back artwork with the request.

name: A5 handout flyer

name: Kraft letterheads
description: Letterheads with a natural kraft paper look. Share the paper weight and print colours you want quoted.

name: Self-inking logo stamp

name: Pocket stamp
description: A compact stamp format for carrying between desks or sites. Share the required imprint and preferred size.

name: Window business envelopes
description: Business envelopes with an address window for invoices and letters. Request the document fit, window position and print design.

name: Lined invitation envelopes
description: Envelopes with a decorative lining for invitations and gift notes. Ask for a size and lining that suit your card.

name: Matte kiss-cut sticker sheets
description: Multiple peel-off designs on a single sheet for events, packaging or stationery. Request the sheet size and individual shapes.

name: Vinyl product labels

name: Cobalt and chrome pen
description: A bright cobalt barrel is framed by a polished silver-tone cap and tip. Two narrow silver bands add a crisp detail near the lower barrel.

name: Ruby red and gold pen
description: A glossy ruby-red barrel meets a straight gold-tone clip and matching tapered tip. The slender profile brings a bright accent to a gift set.

name: Crimson black-clip click pen
description: A satin crimson barrel pairs with a wide black clip, black push button and tapered black tip. The angular shoulder gives the two-tone design a sporty look.

name: Royal blue black-clip click pen
description: A deep royal-blue barrel catches the light along its sides. The long black clip and matching push button keep the finish clean and understated.

name: Matte black click pen
description: A matte black barrel, broad rounded clip and matching push button create an all-black look. The straight body narrows neatly at the tip.

name: Gloss black and silver dome pen
description: A rounded black crown tops a glossy barrel with a curved silver-tone clip. A bright centre band and tapered silver-tone tip repeat the contrast.

name: Gold barrel black-cap pen
description: A satin gold-tone barrel sits below a glossy black cap. A long gold-tone clip and a short black end cap balance the two finishes.

name: Satin gold and black pen
description: A satin gold-tone finish runs across the cap and barrel, with polished gold trim and a curved clip. Black end details frame the gold finish.

name: Gold dome pen
description: A slim satin gold-tone barrel tapers into a polished gold-tone tip. A rounded black crown and a narrow curved clip give the profile its character.

name: Matte black gold-bar clip pen
description: A straight gold-tone clip follows the edge of a rounded matte black cap. A single gold-tone band marks the join above the tapered barrel.

name: Rounded matte black pen
description: A softly rounded cap and a curved black clip flow into a slim tapered barrel. The low-sheen black finish lets the silver-tone lettering stand out.

name: Silver sparkle and gold pen
description: A fine silver sparkle texture covers the cap and barrel. A gold-tone arrow-shaped clip, slim bands and black ends frame the textured finish.

name: Matte black open-clip pen
description: An open-loop black clip arcs away from the barrel. A tapered crown and fine centre seam keep the rest of the matte black design simple.

name: Matte black short-clip pen
description: A compact black clip and a glossy stepped crown contrast with the matte barrel. A slim ring at the join defines the upper section.

name: Matte black sculpted-clip pen
description: A sculpted black clip sits close to the cap, with a shallow wave running down its length. The matte barrel finishes in a smooth, narrow taper.

name: Textured gold arrow-clip pen
description: A fine-grained gold-tone finish catches light across the cap and barrel. A polished arrow-shaped clip and glossy black end pieces add definition.

name: Slate grey and silver click pen
description: A muted slate-grey barrel pairs with a brushed silver-tone push button and tip. The long, flat clip follows the straight lines of the barrel.

name: Gloss black and gold flat-clip pen
description: A wide gold-tone clip sits against a slender gloss black barrel. The matching gold-tone tip repeats the bright finish at the other end.

name: Espresso brown click pen
description: A glossy espresso-brown barrel is finished with a smoky metallic-tone push button and a straight matching clip. The deep brown tip continues the tonal look.

name: Gloss black gold arrow-clip pen
description: A polished gold-tone arrow-shaped clip runs down a glossy black cap. Fine gold-tone rings at the crown, centre and end frame the long black barrel.

name: Burgundy click pen
description: A glossy burgundy barrel, clip and push button share a deep wine-red finish. The slim body and matching tip give the design a uniform look.

name: Brushed champagne and gold pen
description: A muted champagne-tone barrel has a fine brushed finish. The rounded gold-tone crown, long curved clip and narrow bands add a warm contrast.

name: Brushed silver arrow-clip pen
description: A brushed silver-tone barrel meets a faceted polished crown. The feather detail on the arrow-shaped clip and a narrow dark centre ring set it apart.

name: Matte black gunmetal-tip pen
description: A flat-topped matte black barrel carries a straight inset clip. A smoky gunmetal-tone tip gives the otherwise dark design a small reflective accent.

name: Brushed silver smooth-clip pen
description: Fine brush lines run across the silver-tone cap and barrel. A smooth curved clip, rounded polished crown and thin centre band complete the monochrome finish.

name: Black curved silver-clip pen
description: A broad curved silver-tone clip stands out against a softly tapered black body. A rounded crown, wide silver-tone band and short bright tip echo the clip.

name: Gloss black silver arrow-clip pen
description: A glossy black body sets off a silver-tone arrow-shaped clip with a feather detail. A faceted crown, polished centre band and bright tip complete the look.

name: Black and gold chevron-clip pen
description: A gold-tone clip with a raised chevron pattern gives the matte black cap a distinctive detail. A faceted crown and gold-tone centre band match the tapered tip.

name: Black and gold dome pen
description: A polished gold-tone dome and long sculpted clip sit above a tapered black barrel. A narrow centre band and matching gold-tone tip repeat the warm accent.

name: Brushed silver gold-tip pen
description: A brushed silver-tone barrel is paired with a long gold-tone clip and rounded gold-tone crown. A gold-tone centre ring and tapered tip tie the finish together.
